name: app-dark-fitness-dashboard-with-coral-gradient-hero-and-calendar
title: Dark bento fitness dashboard: month calendar, coral portrait hero, gradient progress bars and small widgets
whatItIs: A charcoal bento dashboard with a left icon rail, a month activity calendar with coral selected date and dots, three progress bars with tinted gradients (water, steps, calories), a large coral-to-maroon hero card with a portrait and 'Your Body, Your Power.', a weekly bar chart and two widgets for timer and hydration.
whatItMeans: Warm and powerful; coral on charcoal feels energetic yet calm.
techniques: Build a bento of rounded dark cards.
Use coral as the single accent.
Give progress bars a soft gradient.
Add a large photographic hero card.

vocabulary.definition: A dashboard of varied rounded tiles.
A highlighted day in a calendar.
A bar with a tinted gradient fill.
A large photo card at the top.
